LG Innotek and NVIDIA collaborate on direct sensor-to-GPU connectivity

A 3-megapixel camera and Multimodal Vision System use Holoscan Sensor Bridge, with robot vision and hands on the roadmap.

PR Newswire ↗22 October 2026English editorial summary
Story

Sensing products shown in Berlin

LG Innotek announced the NVIDIA collaboration on October 22 after presenting a 3-megapixel camera and Multimodal Vision System at GTC Berlin on October 20. The products are designed around Holoscan Sensor Bridge for robot and machine sensing.

Shortening the data path

HSB uses an open Ethernet-connected fabric to send sensor data to GPU-based AI computing without routing it through the CPU. LG Innotek brings camera, lidar and radar capabilities to the work. The goal is a shorter sensing-to-inference path, but no measured latency was disclosed.

Vision and hands remain expansion plans

The companies plan further humanoid vision-sensing and robotic-hand work, with additional systems to be shown at CES and GTC in 2027. Pricing and delivery schedules were not specified. Planned hand-related work should not be treated as a finished product available today.
